subject: SAML RelayState truncation blocking Workday onboarding links
messages:

Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding links dropping into 'blackhole' (Workday invite)

Hi Jonas,

We're seeing a problem with the bulk onboarding invites your team generated yesterday for ClearSky Medical. When users click the link in the email it briefly hits our SSO domain and then ends up at a generic 404/"no session" page on the Workday supplier portal (no error message beyond that). This is happening for ~15 of ~120 suppliers so far.

What we tried:
- Re-sent the invite to one affected user (same result)
- Opened the link in incognito and different browsers (same redirect)
- Contacted our Okta admin; they see the redirect to Okta but then a follow-up redirect to Workday returns a 302 -> 404.

I attached a screenshot of the browser console and the cascade of redirects.

Example invite link (truncated here):
https://onboard.redwood.example/supplier/invite?token=eyJhbGciOiJI...&RelayState=https%3A%2F%2Fworkday.supplier.example%2Fauth%3Ftenant%3Dclearsky%26returnUrl%3D%252Fforms%252Fpo-details%26params%3D...

Can you take a look? We can throw a few users into a staging flow if that helps debug.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot.

I'm escalating to Ben/Platform because this looks like a SAML/RelayState edge case during the Okta handoff. Before they dig in: can you send one of the full raw invite URLs (not truncated) and an example affected user (email + tenant id)? Also please confirm whether the failing users are using the same IdP/Okta org as the working ones.

Plan:
- Ben will pull the proxy logs and the RelayState being sent to Okta.
- If RelayState is being truncated we can switch the invite template to a short-code/lookup flow so the redirect payload is small.
- We can test a short-code invite to a single user in a staging tenant this afternoon.

Monica — looping you in for any process/PO implications and to help coordinate the test.

Jonas

On Sun, Mar 14, 2027 at 9:12 AM Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearskymedical.com> wrote:
> Example invite link (truncated here):
> https://onboard.redwood.example/supplier/invite?token=eyJhbGciOiJI...&RelayState=https%3A%2F%2Fworkday.supplier.example%2Fauth%3Ftenant%3Dclearsky%26returnUrl%3D%252Fforms%252Fpo-details%26params%3D...

Checked the proxy logs and reproduced the flow with a captured invite. Observations: the RelayState parameter we're passing to Okta occasionally exceeds 4096 characters for invites that include a long returnUrl and a JSON-encoded params blob. Okta's service (depending on tenant config) will truncate RelayState above a threshold which results in the downstream SP (Workday) not receiving the expected returnUrl/params and sending users to the default error route.

Attached: idp-headers.log (excerpts) and a sanitized sample-invite-link.txt that shows the full query string.

Immediate mitigations:
1) Short-term: switch invite emails to use a short invitation code that maps to the full redirect payload on our side. The email link would be /invite/code/XYZ which does a server-side lookup and then issues a short (<= 200 char) RelayState. This avoids large query strings to IdP. Implementation estimate: ~3 engineer-days (backend + email template change + QA).
2) Medium-term: add a compacting step when building the returnUrl (base62-encode a params id; store params in DB for 14 days).
3) Coordinate with Okta: request an increased RelayState limit for affected tenants (some customers will accept this, others won't). I've opened a ticket and the support contact is on the CC (I pasted the ID below).

Suggested next steps for this thread:
- Jonas/Monica to confirm whether ClearSky wants the short-code ASAP for the affected suppliers. If yes, we can schedule a small release and run a targeted resend.
- If customer prefers, we can ask Okta to bump the limit — that may take 24–72 hours.

Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick update from our side. Okta support confirmed a RelayState length limit on our tenant that was trimming query params. They pushed a temporary increase and re-ran a handful of invites; the affected users were able to complete the flow and submit onboarding forms.

We'd prefer Redwood implement the short-code mapping for invites so this doesn't recur with other IdPs or long URLs. Can you share the proposed rollout plan and timing? Also tagging Monica to confirm whether re-sending the remaining ~100 invites is necessary after the short-code deploy.

Attached is the Okta ticket response for our records.
